purpose.domain_detail: General Ledger (G/L) account deletion module in an APAC accounting/ERP system
purpose.summary: GLP002 is the 'Delete G/L Account' program in a General Ledger application. It presents a screen-based interactive interface allowing an authorised user to select and delete a general ledger account, with security checks (LS0-GLLEV < 3), recovery file handling, and lookup functionality. It is part of a larger suite of GL programs authored by J.W. Lemmon.

notable_features: SCREEN SECTION with FOREGROUND-COLOR, BACKGROUND-COLOR, HIGHLIGHT
CRT STATUS IS / CURSOR IS / CONSOLE IS CRT special-names
Extensive use of COPY statements (67 copybooks) for file definitions, screen layouts, and working storage
LINKAGE SECTION with security level check (LS0-GLLEV)
REDEFINES used extensively for account number decomposition
GNU GPL v2 license embedded in SECURITY paragraph
WS-CHECK field with encoded author name string
verdict.notes: Source truncated to first 16000 chars; full PROCEDURE DIVISION not visible but structure is clearly production-quality. The program uses latin-1 encoding with some box-drawing characters (³, °) in screen layout literals. The 'online-cics' program_type is used loosely here — this is actually a screen-based interactive terminal program (not CICS), but no better enum value exists for interactive screen programs.
